description: The file is a Java source class defining a fragment used for editing notes in an Android application. It manages UI interactions, autosaving, and note content display within the app.

classes.name: NoteEditFragment
classes.description: A fragment class extending SearchableBaseNoteFragment, managing the note editing UI, text change detection, autosave mechanisms, and note content presentation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the main Handler.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu items visibility for editing and preview modes.

methods.name: getScrollView
methods.description: Returns the ScrollView containing the note content.

methods.name: scrollToY
methods.description: Scrolls the view to a specified Y position.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout of the editable content.

methods.name: getSearchNextButton
methods.description: Returns the button to navigate to the next search result.

methods.name: getSearchPrevButton
methods.description: Returns the button to navigate to the previous search result.

methods.name: getDirectEditingButton
methods.description: Returns the button for direct editing actions.

methods.name: getNormalEditButton
methods.description: Returns null; this fragment does not have a separate normal edit button.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment view with binding.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up TextWatcher for detecting text changes and restores last selection.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current selection state.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reattaches text watcher and handles soft keyboard visibility.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes text watcher and detects keyboard state.

methods.name: cancelTimers
methods.description: Removes pending auto-save callbacks.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns current text content of the note being edited.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves the current note content, resets unsaved flag.

methods.name: autoSave
methods.description: Triggers saves after a delay when user edits content, with callbacks for sync completion.

methods.name: colorWithText
methods.description: Highlights search terms within the note content.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding to the editor UI based on color theme, sets highlight colors.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new fragment instance with account and note IDs.

methods.name: newInstanceWithNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new fragment instance for editing a new note object.
